issues.title: Reduce repeated scientific observer work in verification
issues.body:
Verification repeated independent scientific-observer calculations and serialized unrelated verifier fixtures. This change reuses invocation-local work in qualified observer paths, gives isolated verifier suites their own whole-file affinity groups, and compiles the unchanged ImageJ observer once while retaining every fresh reader observation.

The current full `make verify` passed in **600.76 seconds** on this machine, versus **598.57 seconds** at the previous PR head. The five-minute target was **not reached**, and no whole-run improvement over the previous head was demonstrated. The original required baseline took 2287.89 seconds. Focused probes improved, but those timings are not a full-suite speedup claim.

The owner accepted this checkpoint and asked to stop optimization and update this PR. That supersedes the earlier 300-second runtime target for this submission. All correctness, coverage and review requirements remain; the installed two-worker policy is unchanged.

<details>
<summary>Technical appendix: changes, preservation and verification</summary>

- **Scientific observers:** expanded ordinary native reconstruction to multiple orders and qualified full-table sampling; preserved all eight actual trilinear vertices, including zero weights and aliases. Geometry/sampling facts are shared only within one reconstruction with complete nominal/error/dtype/shape keys and fresh output storage. Uncertain support certificates are staged in original order, with transactional fallback preserving the first scalar failure. Nominal complex operations retain their scalar dispatch. All original scientific obligations, parameter examples, assertions and tolerances remain.
- **Diagnostic preservation:** fresh B8 found an admitted tiny prepared-transfer case with 370 original versus 228 underflow warnings, despite identical numerical/error bytes and nine certificates. New packed families, cross-component sharing and omitted unused norm-error columns require underflow ignore; unused real-abs metadata is omitted without changing its sign-bit-only value or diagnostics. Other policies retain the accepted legacy paths or literal scalar fallback. No warning filtering/replay, numerical tolerance or scientific domain was changed. Fresh B9 accepted the entire expanded engine and this correction after independent closed numerical, ownership, callback/log/print/raise and failure-prefix checks.
- **Infrastructure:** six isolated files now have independent whole-file groups: verification evidence outputs, receipts, measurement export, output protection, external native evidence and source-free checks. Reader/cache-affine files remain together, new/unlisted files default to `serial-rest`, and exactly two workers/loadgroup/no restart remain. Controlled fake-UV version responses stage installed metadata once; every actual query still records its arguments/status and emits the selected external bytes. Real verifier decisions, native rendering, child coverage and unexpected-argument fallback stay live.
- **Preservation:** original audit 52 files/723 declarations; current 722 declarations/3066 cases. All 26 previously consolidated examples remain:20 clock-label examples in five loops and six drift assertion sets in their same-case complete-workflow keepers. This update changes no further case/declaration. All 3066 normalized identities match the previous PR head; versus the original baseline the exact delta remains 26 removed/5 added/3061 unchanged. Scientific product code, independent CE08 suites/oracles/example, frozen Java reader source, Makefile, dependencies/lock, workflows, exclusions and gate policy remain unchanged. No PR 83 changes were imported.
- **Exact candidate:** `59b8f8d9598d2413144c0e2878221e781981a1f3`, tree `3945dc2901a8acf1a0209736703c048d16c95104`, clean and unchanged before/after canonical verification. Required measurement base `edcf53b5d5c0f494c388944d3cfda5c04b9fda97`; published predecessor `6876e9ea3bd7ffb1feb46c5aec66667646de76cf`; handoff `db5dae9abc06a54e78d31d9cbec46465d55068ae` preserved. Fresh publication fetch at 2026-11-09T17:14:04Z confirms `origin/main` remains the required baseline (0/0 divergence), and the published predecessor is an ancestor of this candidate. The update is a fast-forward; no merge or PR 83 import occurred.
- **Full local gate:** all 13 phases passed; 3066 tests passed/47 warnings; 600.76 s outer,547.429 s JUnit pytest (547.50 s reported). Identical external top-level durations/JUnit wrapper, exec tracing and GNU time were used with the original baseline. Single runs, cache/load and instrumentation effects limit attribution. The 600.76 s result supplies no claim that five minutes or a reliable ten-minute margin was achieved.
- **Focused proof:** infrastructure 341 passed 119.60 s plus 11 runner checks. All 743 native shards remained byte-identical through real fixture cleanup and exact arc-union combine. Scientific 597-case proof passed 226.52 s on the rejected intermediate checkpoint; B9 retained its default-mode execution evidence only after whole-fixture AST mode equivalence and unchanged suite pins. Exact corrected source then passed 313 boundary cases/16 warnings/7.59 s plus 45 policy comparisons. Full canonical verification above executes the final source for every case. Locked lint, formatting and all-file Pyright pass for 116 files.
- **Final independent reviews:** Fresh scientific D and bounded infrastructure reviewers independently ACCEPT this exact candidate with no actionable finding. D retained all 413 original scientific declarations/obligations; bounded retained all 310 infrastructure/neutral declarations and 949 original case identities. Both checked final source/receipt pins and preservation. D report SHA-256 `a52dc2947ec64f7ee9366441f216435efa214c41bcab0db70e3e7c17588b1b07`; bounded report SHA-256 `14333d3a024f02cdc8b823d8fba7764081aa9a068e60cdbc58543d82feea422f`. Reports and verdict/pin receipts remain in ignored `artifacts/test-apparatus-audit/five-minute/final-scientific-d/` and `final-bounded-review/`. Both reviewers report no own live processes or disposable external scratch; reviewer-only corrected diagnostics remain charged.
- **Native coverage:** all 30 owned Python files have complete JSON, HTML and a consistent combined database, including relevant child data. Global 4784/4920 native statements and 1845/1952 branch destinations; library 4032/4167 and 1542/1648; scripts 752/753 and 303/304. The sole change from the predecessor is one covered grouping statement; other file counters/branch counts match. No exclusions were added. Percentages are advisory, report integrity is mandatory. Canonical combine normally consumes raw input shards; post-combine raw retention is not claimed.

- **Same-run M25:** `b64713d2-9934-442a-a026-ae6eebc8a39a`, baseline=peak101140KiB, increment0bytes against the unchanged 33554432-byte limit. This is a high-water observation, not no allocation; no second M25 run was used to retrieve numbers. All 20 fresh genuine reader JVM observations and 27 API report observations are linked to this run.
- **Environment/build:** uv 0.12.19, Python 3.13.12, Temurin 21.0.7+6, isolated Hatchling 1.32.4, locked NumPy 2.5.3/h5py 3.16.0. Authenticated reader inputs and the real locked vulnerability audit pass. Wheel `simrecon-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl` (97933 bytes), SHA-256 `b672d5f16ee9ecefeda57a03be1bf0da3f0b2fffe21a1006b5795de4104f9798`.
- **Accounting and cleanup:**24 known launches across both campaigns, including four original discovery, bounded authors, fresh scientific author/reviewers and final independent reviews; historical PR 83 counts and actual served-model/token/cache/cost/elapsed totals remain unknown. No human execution/review/token/money cap was set. The first new 341 owner run failed due invalid under-repo Git fixture location and coverage overrides; unchanged cases passed in corrected canonical context. A 40.75 s canonical setup failure was caused by an intentional cyclic symlink in retained failed-run scratch; its raw tree was archived and four confirmed disposable trees removed, then the same unchanged candidate passed. Both attempts remain recorded. No gate/source repair was made for those harness/cleanup issues. Current checkout, original data, shared tools/caches/JDK/jars and durable evidence remain; confirmed owner/reviewer scratch is removed or explicitly retained as evidence.
- **Scope/size:** net scientific product 0 lines, runtime test harness+51, tests/support+1484 relative to the required baseline. This reduces repeated work while adding qualified fixture machinery; it is not a test-deletion result. Prior 600-second campaign evidence remains byte-identical, and all rejected experiments/corrections are retained. [Task/resume record](https://github.com/david-hoffman/simrecon/blob/codex/test-apparatus-optimization/docs/tasks/test-apparatus-optimization.md) · [new campaign evidence](https://github.com/david-hoffman/simrecon/tree/codex/test-apparatus-optimization/docs/reports/test-apparatus-audit/five-minute). Historical 'not ready' and pending four-worker notes in frozen records are superseded only by the owner's explicit acceptance/stop instruction above; no four-worker migration occurred.
- **CI:** At 2026-11-09T17:16:44Z, new-head [Verify 319](https://github.com/david-hoffman/simrecon/actions/runs/42662971508) is queued; no Ubuntu/macOS success is claimed for this candidate. Previous head 6876's Verify 318 succeeded; that is not CI proof of this new head. No merge is requested or performed.
